mechanism: The activity writer already inserts dated adjacent-turn items. At the focal write, additionally index the visible pieces of its two constituent turns using the same frozen Qwen encoder. A query scores a two-turn item by 0.5 original whole-item cosine plus 0.5 maximum child cosine. Single-turn items, earlier writes, generated memories, the five parent reader slots and parent text are unchanged. Never index any words clipped out of a 96-word parent. Rotate child key sets to the next two-turn parent in the same span as a storage-matched negative control. Motivated by late interaction, not a token-level ColBERT implementation.
source_screen: Before collecting new reader scores, process every chronological session and every non-adversarial question in the six registered training dialogues. Report unresolved or missing gold separately. For each span hold all other spans at dated single turns. Compute the difference in top-five gold-turn recall when that one span switches from singles to keyed adjacent pairs. Include displacement losses on questions whose evidence is elsewhere. Divide summed differences by the number of questions linked to that span, with denominator at least one. This is an auxiliary retrieval target, never a rule-2 selection reward.
policy: Fit six leave-one-dialogue-out ridge regressions with an unpenalized intercept and unit slope penalty, average squared loss, using pre-question source features: mean cosine loss of child vectors against their own parent, upper-quartile mean of those losses and fraction of two-turn parents. Center and scale on donor spans only. Clip predicted auxiliary gain divided by .05 to [-2,2], add to native activity logit. In the source-only screen base logit is zero. Evaluate a full-history greedy schedule plus all cyclic rotations preserving each history's exact number of keyed spans, always singles, always adjacent, always keyed and always rotated keys. Keep coverage, mean retrieved words and per-dialogue/type recall.
reader: Use all original questions of the 12 sessions 5-6 and 7-8 training windows with a fixed temporal first action. Rebuild real temporal and activity banks from verified writes, reproduce their question-level ordered reads and measured answers before comparison. Only change ranking keys for live raw adjacent-turn inserts from the terminal activity span. A receipt with an unreproduced control remains in the denominator for coverage and is excluded from matched comparisons. Reuse identical prompts within the same question from measured controls. Evaluate the actual greedy reader for new contexts. Dataset references are used only after constructing prompts. Preserve raw F1, answers, token use, hashes and the rotated-key ablation. Freeze all source-offsets on other dialogues before new answers. The soft policy mixes measured temporal and keyed-activity F1 using one shared span probability. Compare original native and terminal policies, native probability on the new index, fixed actions and a constant matched to the candidate's mean probability across windows. Report the effect of index change at native propensity separately from moving the propensity with index fixed.
decision: The source screen establishes recall and capacity, not F1. The reader panel is a 91-question training mechanism check. Require gain of .02 vs native and terminal, positive incremental probability effect vs the new native and rate controls, positive in four histories, and inspect key-only vs rotated-key F1 before independent validation. Substantial gains for always-keyed alone are infrastructure effects. Independent full-history LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S remain locked.
